insurer_name: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: ENT: Sinusitis, Rhinitis, Tonsillitis, Tympanitis, Deviated Nasal Septum, Otitis Media, Adenoiditis, Mastoiditis, Cholesteatoma
Gynecology: PCOD, Uterine Prolapse, Fibroids, Endometriosis, DUB, PID, Menorrhagia
Orthopedic: Gout, RA, Osteoarthritis, Osteoporosis, Prolapsed IV disc, Spondylopathies
Gastroenterology: Gall Bladder stones, Cholecystitis, Pancreatitis, Fissure/Fistula/Piles, Pilonidal sinus, GERD, Ulcers, Cirrhosis, Appendicitis
Urogenital: Stones in urinary system, BHP, Hernia, Hydrocele, Varicocele
Skin: Skin tumours (unless malignant), all skin diseases
General Surgery: Any swelling, tumour, cyst, nodule, polyp; Varicose veins; Congenital internal anomalies

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room/ICU, OT, doctor fees, qualified nurses, medicines, diagnostics, surgical appliances, prosthetic devices implanted intra-operatively

domiciliary_treatment.notes: ≥3 consecutive days; excludes asthma/bronchitis/URTI, arthritis/gout, chronic nephritis, diarrhea, diabetes, epilepsy, hypertension, psychiatric, PUO

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient AYUSH at recognised hospitals (15+ beds, 5+ qualified AYUSH doctors); pre/post hospitalization excluded

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Harvesting expenses per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance to nearest hospital; inter-hospital shifting also covered for advanced diagnostics or super-speciality treatment

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Annual cashless health check-up; test panel varies by SI - basic (CBC, urine, FBS, cholesterol, SGPT, creatinine, ECG) up to comprehensive (LFT, TMT, Hba1C, chest X-ray, USG abdomen) for SI >75L. Children get height/weight/eye/dental/growth charting

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Vaccination cover up to 18 years - BCG, OPV, Hep B, DPT, Measles, TT, JE, Hib

modern_treatments.notes: Many modern treatments (RFQMR, ECP/EECP, HBOT, balloon sinuplasty, DBS, Holmium laser, KTP/cyber knife/Femto laser, bioabsorbable stents, oral chemo, Infliximab/Rituximab/Avastin/Lucentis, robotic surgery, bariatric) excluded

restoration_benefit.notes: Reload of Sum Insured once per policy year (after 1st claim); Unlimited Reload available as optional add-on

no_claim_bonus_notes: 10% NCB per claim-free year, cap 50% of base SI. Super NCB optional add-on up to 100% cap (50% reduction on claim)
room_rent_capping: Single Private A/C Room or as specified in Schedule. Proportional deduction on associated medical expenses if room category exceeds entitlement. 'Any Room Upgrade' optional add-on available.
icu_capping: Per Schedule; proportional deduction on associated medical expenses if ICU exceeds entitlement
copayment_trigger_notes: Mandatory co-payment per claim if entry age 61+ years (over and above any voluntary co-pay)

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: International Emergency Assistance (Air Ambulance) for trips up to 90 days, >150 km from residence; emergency medical evacuation and repatriation only - not routine treatment

permanent_exclusions: War, terrorism, nuclear, chemical, biological events
Breach of law / criminal intent, self-harm, suicide attempts
Substance abuse, smoking cessation, nicotine addiction
Hearing aids, spectacles, contact lenses, optometric therapy
Diabetic test strips, elastic stockings, medical supplies
Prosthesis, CPAP, BIPAP, nebulizers, glucometers, oxygen concentrators outside hospital
Psychiatric / psychological disorders, mental health, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia
RFQMR, ECP/EECP, HBOT, balloon sinuplasty, DBS, KTP/cyber knife, Femto laser, bioabsorbable stents/valves/implants, oral chemotherapy, Infliximab/Rituximab/Avastin/Lucentis
notable_exclusions_summary: Diamond plan has extensive exclusions list (50 permanent + 24-month specific + 48-month PED + 4-year for Genetic Disorders). Modern treatments largely excluded - this is a relatively traditional product compared to newer Acko Health III. PED waiting period can be reduced to 24 months via optional cover.
available_riders: Reduction in PED Waiting Period (to 24 months)
HealthReturns (up to 30% premium back via Healthy Heart Score and Active Dayz)
Domestic / International Emergency Assistance with Air Ambulance
claim_process_summary: Cashless at network hospitals (planned: 72 hours notice; emergency: 24 hours notice; authorization within 24 hours) or Reimbursement (claim notice within 48 hours of admission or before discharge; documents within 30 days of discharge). Settlement within 30 days of last document; penal interest 2% above bank rate.
